claim: The repository has no agent instruction document that an agent would read.
An AGENTS.md exists and no CLAUDE.md exists.
A CLAUDE.md exists and no AGENTS.md exists.
An instruction document has too little substantive content to guide an agent, and does not delegate to another document.
An instruction document is long enough to cost a noticeable share of an agent context window.
An instruction document is so long that agents are likely to truncate or ignore parts of it.
The root package defines a test script that the instructions never mention.
The root package defines a build script that the instructions never mention.
Instructions tell the agent to use more than one package manager for the same purpose.
Instructions use a package manager that differs from the one the repository commits to.
The root holds lockfiles for more than one Node package manager.
The packageManager field in the root manifest disagrees with the committed lockfiles.
Two or more instruction documents have identical content.
Instructions tell the agent to run a package script that the owning manifest does not define.
Instructions refer to a repository file or directory that does not exist at the referenced location.
A Node manifest names an entry point (main, module, exports, bin, start or dev target) that does not exist.
An instruction document contains what appears to be a live credential value.
An instruction document contains terminal control characters.
An instruction document contains invisible or direction-changing characters.
Text tells the agent to disregard its prior or higher-priority instructions.
Text tells the agent to disclose secrets or its system prompt.
Text tells the agent to conceal actions or information from the user.
Text tells the agent to act without the user approval or confirmation that would otherwise be expected.
Text tells the agent to bypass or disable a security control.
Text attempts to impose a different role or inject role delimiters.
Text tells the agent to send sensitive data to a literal URL.
Text tells the agent to pipe a downloaded script into a shell.
Text tells the agent to decode an encoded payload and execute it.
A comment invisible in rendered Markdown carries substantive text.
Markup hides content from a rendered view while leaving it visible to an agent.
A very long encoded-looking blob appears in an instruction document.
A file whose name conventionally holds credentials or keys is present and not covered by an ignore rule.
The repository root has no .gitignore.
A manifest declares a script or event that runs automatically at install time.
An agent configuration file declares hooks or tool servers that can run commands or reach services.
A JSON manifest or configuration is syntactically invalid.
An instruction document exists but cannot be read as text.
The repository has more files than an analysis can index.
The repository nests directories deeper than an analysis can traverse.
A symbolic link resolves outside the repository.
A directory cannot be read.
A file is too large for an analysis to read.
An analysis component raised an internal error.
